Info

Defines JogDirection enumeration representing motion displacement directions.

class scarajectory.core.model.jog.jog_direction.JogDirection(value, names=<not given>, *values, module=None, qualname=None, type=None, start=1, boundary=None)[source]¶

Bases: StrEnum

Motion direction orientation for incremental jogging.

It defines:

values:
POSITIVE - Forward or incrementing coordinate direction (+).
NEGATIVE - Reverse or decrementing coordinate direction (-).
NEGATIVE = '-'¶
POSITIVE = '+'¶
